pages.title: "STL-L" Arc Emitter
pages.text: Because an editor accidentally omitted the word "magnetic," AeroIE's weapons division found itself assigned to develop a new 1000 mm "electric cannon."$(br2)Everyone noticed the absurd mistake only when the finished product was delivered. Regardless, the resulting weapon—which forms a powerful electrical arc between its muzzle and target—proved unexpectedly effective.$(br2)Its penetration exceeds that of ordinary electromagnetically propelled shells, making it especially effective against heavily armored hostile subspaces.
